title: Composition of regular ring maps
statement: Let $A\to B$ and $B\to C$ be regular ring maps [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] of commutative rings. If for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$ the fibre ring $C\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] of the composite $A\to C$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], then the composite $A\to C$ is a regular ring map.
